title: NEURONIX Operational Contract Envelope (OCE) Schema
description: Formal typed contract defining operational changes in the NEURONIX Universal Operational Environment.

envelope_id.description: Deterministic unique identifier for the operational contract envelope.

created_at_ms.description: POSIX timestamp in milliseconds when the envelope was minted.

intent.description: Semantic definition of what operational transition is requested.

category.description: Execution category: READ (side-effect free), PROPOSE (dry-run simulation), MUTATE (state-altering).

description.description: Human-readable description of the operational goal.

target_resource_uri.description: Canonical URI for the target operational resource (e.g. neuronix://systemd/service).

session_nonce.description: Cryptographic anti-replay nonce for the session.

authority.description: Cryptographic delegation or approval token authorizing execution.

tier.description: Authority tier granted to the actor.

token.description: Cryptographic delegation token ID (e.g. DEL-HUMAN-OPERATOR-VALID) or Ed25519 signature.

expires_at.description: POSIX timestamp expiry for the authority grant.

environment.description: Target execution environment constraints and provider preferences.

target_substrate.description: Target host or container substrate (e.g. NIXOS_HOST, CONTAINER_OCI, ROOTFS_BWRAP).

isolation_tier.description: Hyperion isolation tier (e.g. TIER_0_HOST, TIER_1_SANDBOX, TIER_2_MICROVM).

provider_preference.description: Ordered list of preferred execution provider IDs.

preconditions.description: Required state and hardware invariants before execution begins.

required_state_root.description: Expected SHA-256 StateRoot digest before operation applies.

expected_effects.description: Declared diff and side-effects expected from execution.

declared_diff.description: Structured diff of expected filesystem, service, or configuration state.

destructive.description: Whether this operation modifies or deletes durable state.

rollback_recipe.description: Deterministic instruction or command to roll back changes upon failure.

invariants.description: Security and operational invariants enforced during execution.

evidence.description: Input cryptographic digests and prior lineage receipts.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of input parameters and files.

prior_receipts.description: Lineage hashes of ancestor execution receipts.

outcome.description: Final or intermediate outcome of the operational envelope.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the envelope.

receipt_id.description: ID of the associated ExecutionReceipt once executed.

error_message.description: Diagnostic error message if rejected or failed.
